readout.notes: reflex-serve reads label logits in-process from the frozen model (markdown prompt, two option orders averaged). Optional --backend sglang reads the same logits from SGLang; not a generic OpenAI endpoint.
readout.portable_notes: Unmodified CPU and MPS author server available for the frozen stable Qwen3.5-4B base (no adapter). https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kshetrajna12/reflex/231f896d818a62b94fec305ed553df1088486dcb/src/reflex/server.py L240: ap.add_argument("--dtype", default="bfloat16", choices=["bfloat16", "float16", "float32"]); L241: ap.add_argument("--device", default="cuda", choices=["cuda", "mps", "cpu"]); L288: dtype=getattr(torch, args.dtype),; L289: device=args.device,. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kshetrajna12/reflex/231f896d818a62b94fec305ed553df1088486dcb/src/reflex/engine.py L290: model_id, dtype=dtype, device_map=device, attn_implementation=attn_implementation; L293: from reflex.mps import patch_delta_rule. README L212–217 recommends float16 rather than bfloat16 on MPS and says 4B does not fit an 18 GB Mac under its memory cap. Therefore MPS variant is honestly labelled fp16-torch-mps, not bf16. Two option orders mean two forwards per question. In-process logits / SGLang-specific readout means backend_agnostic=false.
